Mark tag produces highlighted output

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>This is <mark>highlighted text</mark> in a sentence.</p>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result);
```
